correctness.rationale: Bao's rank criteria apply in the non-degenerate case for every rational u not equal to plus or minus 1. Exact identities give the first summand rank 1 and the middle summand rank 2. The third-summand cube condition is equivalent to a rational point on Y^2=X^3+16; LMFDB 27.a4 has rank 0 and torsion Z/3Z, so only the excluded parameters u=plus or minus 1 occur. Symbolic verification independently checks all specialized algebra and the displayed rational sections.

originality.rationale: Bao's current v1 gives parametric rank-three examples of decomposition type (1,1,1) but only one numerical example of type (1,2,0). The older Desjardins--Naskrecki and Kloosterman results treat the smaller two-coefficient family. No prior source was found giving the displayed rational one-parameter (1,2,0) family or an equivalent parametrization. The motivating preprint is extremely recent, so unindexed contemporaneous work remains the main residual risk.

value.rationale: The result turns an isolated maximal-rank mechanism into an explicit infinite rational family and explains it through two conjugate cube identities plus a global Mordell-curve obstruction. It supplies a concrete reusable construction inside a newly classified parameter space rather than a routine numerical specialization.
